errors.evidence: The description claims that the vertical axis is labeled with a '%' symbol. However, the image shows that the vertical axis has no label at all. The '%' symbol is part of the data labels on top of each bar.
The description fails to mention that the bars are sorted in descending order of their values from left to right.

errors.text_span: и осигуряват визуално разграничение между категориите
errors.evidence: The description states that the diagonal lines used to fill the bars provide a visual distinction between the categories. This is illogical, as all bars use the exact same fill pattern. The fill pattern does not differentiate the categories; their position on the x-axis does.
